evidence: Touches src/index/*, extracts block filter index lifecycle helpers into node/indexes, and removes global index pointers (g_txindex, g_txospenderindex, g_coin_stats_index, g_filter_indexes).
rationale: Encapsulating index ownership within NodeContext decouples the indexing framework from process-global state. The change removes static global pointers (`g_txindex`, `g_filter_indexes`, etc.) and isolates block filter registry helpers, which improves encapsulation and unblocks multiprocess architectural work without affecting indexing runtime behavior.
